pages.title: Brass and Assembly
pages.text: **Brass** is the second tier of Create metal, made by mixing copper and zinc in a heated basin. Brass casings and parts open up funnels with filters, tunnels, mechanical arms and more.

pages.title: Brass Ingot
pages.text: Copper plus zinc in a mixer over a heated burner. See [#](2E5AAC)[Processing](entry://create_basics/processing)[#]().

A **Precision Mechanism** is made by **sequenced assembly**: one item goes through a chain of steps on a belt, repeated several times. It becomes an **incomplete** item in between. The steps use deployers and a press.

pages.title: Precision Mechanism
pages.text: Needed for many advanced machines in several mods. The recipe has a small chance of giving other items. Check JEI for the loop.

pages.title: Mechanical Crafter
pages.text: Arrange several in a grid and connect their paths to craft any recipe, even ones too big for the mixer. Fill every slot, then it crafts.

Mechanical crafters need rotation. Use a wrench to arrange paths, and slot covers to leave holes in the grid.

The **Mechanical Crafter** works with packages too, see [#](2E5AAC)[Logistics](entry://create_basics/packages)[#]().
